# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 1 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Jerusalem Cries Out — Sinners Violate the Sanctuary

---

**1:1** I cried out — I screamed to the LORD
in the day of distress, when sinners swarmed over me.

**1:2** Suddenly war thundered at my gate;
'He will hear me,' I thought — 'am I not righteous before him?'

**1:3** I was proud in my own heart of my righteousness;
I had flourished, I had many children, all was well.

**1:4** Their riches flowed to the ends of the earth,
their name rang out to the farthest shores.

**1:5** They climbed until they touched the stars
and said, 'We cannot fall — we shall never fall.'

**1:6** In their fat prosperity they grew arrogant;
they lost all wisdom and understanding.

**1:7** Their sins went underground, hidden even from me —
I did not see what they had done.

**1:8** Their lawlessness eclipsed all the nations before them;
they desecrated the LORD's holy sanctuary without shame.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance.*
